text: Frame uses pilot exclusions in order: no distinct syntactically valid nonself recorded W refs; then no positive citation evidence by any of three local tests. No type exclusions. Team size is works.authors_count. Draw exactly 8000; round-robin from strata in increasing team-size order until full or each stratum exhausted, then PCG64(42) with one generator and sequential choice without replacement from UTF/lexicographically sorted W IDs in each stratum. Store stratum N/n, pi and inverse pi.

For each date-filtered citing-work query use group_by=publication_year, per_page=200, no select (rejected together), sum group counts only after verifying against meta.count, and treat absent years as zero. Validate grouped year/date correspondence, main and fixed sums, and edge classification. For ordered union chunks, exclude every ID in earlier chunks via repeated cites:! filters. For URL overflow only, exact hybrid: high-cited reference prefix plus F, with ordered disjoint grouped counts for prefix union; date-bearing cursors for each remaining chunk excluding entire prefix; dedup residual IDs across chunks. Scan F with outbound edges independently to find F and I. Local citation totals only affect prefix efficiency, not inclusion.

All windows use strictly later focal publication dates in the current global OpenAlex graph (not reconstructed as-of edges), main capped at 2026-11-23. Fixed end is Dec 31 of y+2. 2021–23 support complete cutoff dates relative to snapshot (not guaranteed index completeness); 2024 true fixed endpoint still in future relative to collection clock and cannot be observed. API even returned 39 future-dated records in one test branch, which do not establish complete future follow-up. Preserve main and mark observed fixed through 2026-11-23 separately; true 2024 fixed counts are null. Keep mathematical D for U>0, and flag strict F>0.

Reference metadata is lifetime global OpenAlex cited_by_count and publication_year, not at-focal-publication popularity. Prefer matched local snapshot values; a systematic 100-local-ID spot check matched all years/totals to live. Use verified 100-ID ids.openalex batches with only id/year/citation-total selected for remaining unique IDs; preserve returned zero versus no exact ID match, partial records and request failure separately. Cache/persist pilot metadata and do not re-request IDs in it.

Production budget model uses real successful-list rate $0.0001, 25,031 uncached group calls after keeping 18 grouped probes, 3,588 remaining reference batches, and 235 projected long-route cursor pages after exact prefix-excluded counts. Reserve 10% additional requests and 300 extra. Total $3.2299 before trivial extra validations/dispatch recovery; launch only while session and daily-plus-prepaid ceilings cover it. Retain one retry and per-stream cursor cardinality/date/duplicate checks; no substitutions. 100 locally matched reference records identical to live in the audit; no claim that every local/live value is immutable.

Use design-rescaled multinomial replicates by team-size stratum (zero direct variance for census strata) and rerank within year in each replicate. Main gradients summarize log2-size slope over authors 1–10; C3 direct extreme-impact slope contrast; C4 support fixed from observed sample, no universality inference. In C5 keep age zero, exclude negative ages from age only, retain all nonnegative popularity counts independent of age; inference resamples focal works and conditions on observed reference metadata/shared graph.

Stage 1 primary D retains mathematically defined zero-F rows; positive-F sensitivity matches the original citation restriction more closely. Impact and attention use global postdate F counts, not snapshot lifetime citations. Weighted within-publication-year midranks and finite-population design replicates; fixed effects use author/work clustering. True fixed window excludes 2024 (late-2026 follow-up not observable). [T33,T49,T50,T55,T61–T63,J11,J12]

Reference age is year difference: keep same year, exclude negative ages only from age. Popularity is current citations, not as of focal publication; analyze metric-specific coverage and report work-weighted primary and edge-weighted sensitivity, with focal-work intervals conditional on the graph. [T45,T57–T60,T65,J11]

Stage 2: hold the Stage-1 8,000 draws and inverse inclusion weights fixed; resample n_h focal works uniformly with replacement within each original stratum, including the 481-work census, then estimate each domain and recompute weighted ranks/bins. F>0 separately in main/fixed; intersect only in paired comparison. C6 strict timing uses fixed-positive cohorts, and retains Stage-1 main-window raw-D sign labels for association (conditional shares already required fixed F>0); U comparator retains original main-U timing base. C5 changes from Stage-1 all-draw reference target to strict main domain, with both U>0 and original all-draw reconstruction. C7 uses original two-way work/author cluster inference with domain-specific outcomes and support, no FPC. P12 is the sole C5 geometry/source; preserve its historical files and register a new slug if same slug would overwrite its files. P9 is not a source.
